plugins.name: ralph-wiggum
plugins.description: Interactive self-referential development loop - runs the same prompt iteratively until completion. This is a bug fix version for address input error in this issue:https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/issues/12170

plugins.name: shopify-insight-report
plugins.description: Builds a merchant-facing insight report from a store's own Shopify analytics (ShopifyQL): finds when a metric broke, which funnel step and segment moved, and whether a suspected change (theme publish, app install, checkout or shipping change, price, discount, campaign, or A/B test) caused it. Delivers a verdict-first HTML report the merchant can re-run query by query. Works with a Shopify MCP, a read-only access token, or CSV exports from the ShopifyQL editor.

plugins.name: rivo-layout-variations
plugins.description: A/B tests the Rivo loyalty app's account widget (the slide-out account and rewards panel) with ABConvert: different buttons, texts, sections, colors or layout per test group. Each test group changes Rivo's own settings right before Rivo draws the widget, so nothing flickers, results can be filtered to shoppers who opened the widget, and a winner copies straight into Rivo's admin. Needs ABConvert's MCP connected to the store.
